title: SIMINTERVIEW: TRANSFORMING BUSINESS EDUCA TION THROUGH LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL-BASED SIMULATED MULTILINGUAL INTERVIEW TRAINING SYSTEM

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM performance metrics (Assessment Alignment, Content Preservation, and User Experience) between Western/English and Japanese interview simulations to evaluate how well the models adapt to distinct cultural recruitment norms and standardized versus flexible resume formats.
Evaluating and comparing system effectiveness, retrieval accuracy, and user satisfaction across English and Japanese language interactions.
